title: KAIST Declares Physical AI Vision With President Demonstrating Wearable Robot
source_used: DongA Science (read in full from the pre-fetched text)
key_facts: KAIST, a research university in Daejeon, South Korea, said on 11 Oct 2026 that it will host 'Physical AI KOREA 2026' on its Daejeon main campus on 13 Oct.
It plans to present a physical AI framework joining its research in robotics, AI, sensors, actuators and data, with strategies for research, education and startups.
KAIST defines physical AI as sensing the real world, moving suitably, and swarm intelligence in which several robots share information; humanoids are 'just one form'.
It wants platforms usable in manufacturing, healthcare, defense, logistics and daily life.
President Bae Choong-sik is scheduled to proclaim a vision for a national physical AI industrial ecosystem and to wear and demonstrate a wearable robot from Professor Kong Kyung-chul's team.
Five teams will show work, including a humanoid that can carry objects over 15 kg (Professor Park Hae-won) and a humanoid pilot robot called PIBOT (Professor Shim Hyun-chul).
The event is open to anyone interested; registration closes at noon on 12 Oct.
quote_evidence: KAIST stated on the 11th that it will host “Physical AI KOREA 2026” at the KI Building on its Daejeon main campus on October 13.
On the day of the event, KAIST President Bae Choong-sik will personally wear and demonstrate the wearable robot developed by Professor Kong’s team.

Humanoids are seen as just one form that embodies these technologies, and KAIST plans to secure platform technologies that can be deployed not only in manufacturing but also in fields such as healthcare, defense, logistics, and everyday life.
why_it_matters_hint: A leading Korean university wants physical AI to be seen as more than humanoids, but this is a planned event and nothing has been shown yet.
event_date: Announced 11 Oct 2026; event scheduled for 13 Oct 2026
notes: The source headline says KAIST 'declares' a vision with the president 'demonstrating', but the event is scheduled for 13 Oct, so the declaration and the demonstration have not yet happened.
